cases.question: Under the final museum loan addendum, give the gallery, humidity band, courier, and return date for vessel Pavo.
cases.answer: Vessel Pavo goes to Gallery Umber at 44–46% humidity with courier Lio March and returns on February 18.

truth_claims.claim: The final addendum assigns vessel Pavo to Gallery Umber.
The designated courier is Lio March.
The contractual return date is February 18.

turns.content: The draft loan placed vessel Pavo in Gallery Ochre at 48–50% humidity with courier Mina Holt and a February 12 return.
Vessel Corvus remains in Gallery Ochre at 48–50% humidity and returns February 12 with Mina Holt.
An unsigned addendum proposed Gallery Umber, 42–44% humidity, courier Mina Holt, and February 15.
Lio March escorts vessel Corvus to Gallery Umber on February 18 for a separate exhibit.
The final addendum assigns vessel Pavo to Gallery Umber. The final humidity band is 44–46%. Earlier drafts and unsigned addenda are superseded.
Gallery Ochre temporarily uses a 44–46% band during maintenance, unrelated to vessel Pavo.
The designated courier is Lio March. The contractual return date is February 18. These terms belong to vessel Pavo's final addendum.
A training ledger mixes Mina Holt, Lio March, February 12, February 15, and February 18 without controlling any loan.

cases.question: For transect T6's accepted sampling plan, state the launch site, depth, preservative, and archive owner.
cases.answer: Transect T6 launches from Cape Iris, samples at 37 meters, uses preservative Zeta-S, and is archived by Noor Fenn.

truth_claims.claim: Transect T6 launches from Cape Iris.
Noor Fenn owns the archive record for T6.

turns.content: Transect T5 launches from Cape Jade and samples at 37 meters.
A practice plan puts T6 at Cape Jade and 27 meters.
The accepted sampling plan states that Transect T6 launches from Cape Iris. Transect T6 samples at 37 meters.
Noor Fenn samples T5 at Cape Jade using preservative Eta-R.
Transect T6 uses preservative Zeta-S. The field vial label is the controlling preservative record.
Preservative Zeta-S is also tested at 27 meters for T5, without changing T6.
Noor Fenn owns the archive record for T6. The field crew does not own the archive.
Cape Iris also hosts a 27-meter T4 sample archived by Remi Ash.

cases.question: From the approved print ledger, report stock, ink, drying interval, and finisher for batch W2.
cases.answer: Batch W2 uses linen stock, ultramarine ink, a 14-hour drying interval, and finisher Cato Wynn.

turns.content: The rejected W2 proof used cotton stock, carmine ink, eight hours of drying, and finisher Mira Doss.
W1 uses linen stock, carmine ink, fourteen hours of drying, and finisher Mira Doss.
W3 uses cotton stock, ultramarine ink, eight hours of drying, and finisher Cato Wynn.
A training sheet combines linen stock, ultramarine ink, eight hours, and Mira Doss for a fictitious W2.
The approved print ledger supersedes the proof. W2 uses linen stock. W2 uses ultramarine ink. W2 has a 14-hour drying interval. W2 has finisher Cato Wynn.
Cato Wynn finishes W1 only when Mira Doss is absent; the approved W1 row remains unchanged.
Ultramarine ink requires eight hours on cotton stock in a separate drying test.
The workshop comparison board lists W1, W2, and W3 with every stock, ink, interval, and finisher option.
